pronunciation: kee-eh (one quick syllable, like 'kyeh' with a high-level tone)

example.english: Grandma raises a lot of chickens.

note: In Sixian Hakka, 雞 is pronounced 'kie' (tone 1), not like Mandarin 'jī'. Chicken is a staple of Hakka cooking, especially the famous 'white-cut chicken' (白斬雞) served at festivals and ancestor worship.
